**Scope:** Codes were identified using CPRD term searches and checked using code-prefix searches. Binswanger’s disease is included as a subcortical vascular dementia diagnosis. ## Vascular dementia codelist

CPRD Read codes identifying vascular dementia, including arteriosclerotic and multi-infarct dementia and Binswanger’s disease.

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| E004 | Arteriosclerotic dementia |

| Eu01y | [X]Other vascular dementia |
| Eu01z | [X]Vascular dementia, unspecified |
| F21y2 | Binswanger's disease |
| F21y2-1 | Binswanger's encephalopathy |

**Scope:** Binswanger’s disease/encephalopathy is included as a recognised vascular dementia entity. Generic dementia, suspected dementia, history/family-history codes, and screening or administrative codes are excluded. `Eu002` (Alzheimer’s disease, atypical or mixed type) is excluded because it does not specifically establish a vascular component. CADASIL alone is also excluded because it does not establish dementia.

Codes and term variants are reproduced as returned by CPRD.
